title: HUGE MSFS 2024 Airport Drop! RKSI Incheon, LPPR Porto & PAFA Fairbanks Now on PC
description:
MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (April 4, 2026) – RKSI Incheon & PAFA Fairbanks V3!

Welcome to this week’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update for PC! Today, we are exploring massive new "must-have" airport releases for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. The headline additions include the long-awaited RKSI Incheon International Airport and the highly detailed PAFA Fairbanks International Alaska V3.0.

Whether you are looking for MSFS 2024 new airports like SKBO El Dorado V2 and LPPR Porto, or looking to enhance your night flying with DreamScenery road lights, this MSFS PC Marketplace update is packed with content.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Bijan Habashi: EGEW Westray Airport (Scenic Scottish island airstrip)
🛫 Burning Blue Design: EGKR Redhill Aerodrome (Popular UK GA hub)
🛫 France VFR: LFBI Poitiers Biard Airport (Regional French airport)
🛫 imaginesim: TBPB Grantley Adams Intl (Major Caribbean gateway)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KSVR South Valley Regional Airport (Utah general aviation field)
🛫 Realworld Scenery: PAFA Fairbanks International Airport Alaska V3.0 (Alaska cargo & passenger hub)
🛫 SABE Jorge Newbery Airport (Buenos Aires city airport)
🛫 SiamFlight: RKSI Incheon International Airport (Major South Korean international hub)
🛫 Taimodels: LPPR Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport (Porto international airport)
🛫 WINGSIM: SKBO El Dorado Internacional Airport V2 (Updated Bogotá mega hub)
